{"name": "set_contract", "arguments": {"question": "Did the biomarker improve?", "estimand": "The average change in biomarker from baseline to week 12, among patients with valid baseline and final measurements.", "premises": ["The biomarker is measured at baseline and week 12.", "Valid baseline measurements exclude -999.", "Each patient is counted once, using the highest sample_seq row.", "The biomarker change is computed as (biomarker_final - biomarker_baseline).", "The improvement is defined as a decrease in biomarker level, as lower values indicate better clinical outcome.", "The analysis is done on the full cohort, not stratified by arm or site, as the question does not specify subgroups."], "assumptions": ["The assay_batch unit error applies only to biomarker_final, not baseline.", "The correction for assay_batch is applied to all batch-B final values.", "The unit correction does not affect baseline values."}}
</tool_call>
